description: Path patterns for shareable outputs that must pass design + number gates before the agent can claim ready.

claim_check.notes: outputs .md files that state an absence, staleness, assignment, or PM-name claim must carry a | Claim | Source | table. Files with none of those phrases pass untouched. No number gate on these.

ledger_convention.notes: Matches _protocol.md Publish: outputs/.../<artifact-stem>-number-ledger.md next to the source readout / artifact. Ledger may declare ## Gate sources (saved-result paths); check_number_consistency.py loads them so hooks only need --ledger. Add explicit artifact-to-ledger pairs under ledger_by_artifact when a ledger is not the sibling file.
